lines: Your profile now has a page of its own. It starts with your initials.
Your initials sit in the header. Choose them, and Profile opens without reloading the page.
It shows your name, when you joined, your home church and city, your bio, your goals and what you are into, on phone and desktop.
Going to lists the events you registered for, soonest first, each on its day in Toronto.
A brand new profile says what belongs in each section. Not going to anything yet? Browse events is one tap away.
While it loads, the page keeps its shape. If it cannot load, you can try again right where you are.
Only you see this page. The server takes the member from your session, never from the address, and your home church never reaches a log.
Every test failed first. Now they all pass.
Next, slice eighteen point two: edit your profile.
That's slice eighteen point one. Christian Fitness: a Christian community for health in body and spirit.
